parsed.explanation: Tier-1 and tier-2 exposures dominate. The division imposes birth-sex facility mandates (2026 Act) with criminal trespass and a 2019 indecent-exposure statute covering trans bathroom use — universal, inescapable exposure with no documented remedy (no statewide non-discrimination law; complaints record shows nothing working). A standing, upheld criminal ban on gender-expression performance (felony on repeat) is a state restriction on presentation, though its application to trans visitors is unresolved. Documents are effectively closed (no birth-certificate change since 1977; licence refusal), compounding the parent's passport/visa regime, which has already stranded travellers and triggered foreign advisories. Custody placement by birth sex is statutory. Under Rule 16 the 7.8/100k figure (10 deaths, undercount floor) is unusable as a rate; what remains is dated police indifference (2021) and an available trans-panic defence — thin, weak recourse. No documented raids or organised targeting keeps this above the 0.25 tier.
